theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_ic_lct_monomial_expansion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), Q.val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val • MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) (1 : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Compare coefficients at each exponent d. Homogeneity makes both sides vanish when d has degree different from n. Otherwise d uniquely equals the indexed exponent with r.val = d 0, so the sum reduces to the matching coefficient. Coefficient extensionality proves the equality, including n = 0.
